integrity: Proof and equality criteria are written analytically; finite diagnostic checks are supplementary. No independent review, validation, or publication-priority certification has been performed.
limitations: Does not determine the full complex q-Berezin range or extend to arbitrary analytic symbols, boundary point-evaluations, or other RKHS kernels. Earlier equivalent exact formulas might exist.
scope: All complex constants c in the open unit disk and \(0<q\le1\) for scalar Hardy H2; positive-real overlap q of normalized Szego kernels.
title: Sharp \(q\)-Berezin profile and norm-saturation rigidity for Hardy constant-symbol composition
